## Choose the representation for the question {#l2-recap }

| Need to find… | Use… |
|:---|:---|
| The proportion with one value | Relative frequency |
| The proportion at or below a value | Cumulative relative frequency |
| The most frequent value | Ordinary-frequency table or graph |
| The middle observation(s) | Ordered data or cumulative counts |

::: {.takeaway}
State the event or statistic before choosing a column or graph.
:::

::: notes
Final check: Why is the tallest cumulative bar not a way to identify the mode? Answer: cumulative bars are running totals; the last bar normally reaches the full sample size.
:::
